name: gwm
title_zh: 一个命令把 Git 工作树摊成多张并行草稿桌
tagline_zh: 在多个分支间切换不再 stash 来 stash 去。gwm 用 Rust 原生速度列出、创建、清理工作树。
tagline_en: Stop stashing to switch branches. gwm lists, creates, cleans worktrees at Rust speed, materializes PRs into.
desc_en: Manage git worktrees across any repository with the `gwm` Rust binary (CLI + ratatui TUI). Use when the user asks to create / list / remove / bootstrap / switch / link worktrees, run a command across worktrees (`gwm exec`) or reclaim build artifacts (`gwm clean`), materialise a PR into a worktree (`gwm review`), drive a multi-repo workspace (`--workspace`), run the JSON daemon / statusline (`gwm d
why_zh: 不是又一个 git 子命令封装。它自带 TUI 和 JSON daemon，能跨工作树批量执行命令。
why_en: Not another git wrapper. Ships TUI + JSON daemon, execs across worktrees, reclaims build artifacts — turns worktrees from manual.
limit_zh: 需要本机已装 gwm 二进制（Rust 编译或预构建包），且仓库需支持 git worktree。
limit_en: Requires gwm binary installed (Rust build or prebuilt). Works only on git repos with worktree support. No merge/conflict resolution; clean reclaims.
title_en: One command spreads Git worktrees into parallel desks
